request.objective: Start at https://us.megabus.com/. Find out what to do when I lose an item on a bus on us.megabus.

response.result:
Megabus’s FAQ says to report the loss to its Lost and Found department by submitting the linked lost-item inquiry form. The department says it processes reports and responds to all loss inquiries, but an investigation may take several days. Megabus will try to return the item and help with retrieval.

The FAQ link did not lead to a dedicated lost-item form; it opened a general Contact Us page. That page offers its virtual assistant, Chuck, or the email address [email]. The page did not say what details to include in a lost-item report.

args.note: Opening Megabus and looking for its lost-item guidance.
narrations: Opening the Megabus site and looking for its lost-item guidance.
